December 29, 1964
Mr. Burney C. Voum Attorney at Law 121 Ashmun Street P.O. Box 516 Sault Ste. Marie, Michigan 49764
IN REPLY REFER TO: Our File No. 2515 Joan Wiitala, Admex. v. P. Lorillard and American Tobacco Company
Dear Mr. Veum:
I have reviewed your Notion which you have caused to be filed in this matter.
I believe that many of the matters of which you complain at this particular time insofar as the pleadings are concerned can be taken care of by agreement.
When you arrive here, we can perhaps discuss this matter and arrive at some method of satisfying your desires in relation to the Complaint.
Incidentally, if you have not ascertained the time and the date with Judge Brennan, I would suggest that you do so before making the trip in this area as there seems to be a very large number of motions scheduled for the opening day of the term.
Sincerely, WISTI & JAASKELAINEN
Andrew H. Wisti
AHW/cm cc: Joan Wiitala
